This hotel is situated near to Magalluf's business centre, a stone's throw from the beach. There is a golf course just a few kilometres away and copious entertainment attractions are to be found in the immediate vicinity.
This hotel was built in 1973. The air-conditioned establishment comprises a total of 503 rooms. At the accommodation, travellers are welcomed at the reception area with 24-hour reception and a 24-hour check-in/check-out service. Most storeys can be reached by lift. Amenities include a safe and a currency exchange service. Among the culinary options available at the hotel are a restaurant, a café, a bar and a pub. The grounds of the establishment feature a playground and an attractive garden. Additional features at the accommodation include a TV room and a playroom. Those arriving in their own vehicles can leave them in the car park of the hotel. Facilities include medical assistance. Active guests can make use of the bicycle hire service to explore the surrounding area.
Each of the rooms is appointed with air conditioning, central heating and a bathroom. Most rooms feature a balcony with a view for guests' enjoyment. Facilities include a fridge, a telephone, a TV and a safe. The bathrooms have a shower and a bathtub. A hairdryer is also available.
